CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apply_pending_family_person_setup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 v_fp record;v_access record;v_old_primary uuid;v_role text;
begin
 if new.linked_user_id is null
    or (tg_op='UPDATE' and new.linked_user_id is not distinct from old.linked_user_id) then
   return new;
 end if;

 for v_fp in
  select fp.id,fp.family_id
  from public.family_persons fp
  where fp.person_id=new.id and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
 loop
  -- Household role: preserve an existing owner; otherwise pending admin or default member.
  if not exists(
    select 1 from public.family_role_assignments r
    where r.family_id=v_fp.family_id and r.user_id=new.linked_user_id
      and r.status='active' and r.role='owner'
  ) then
    v_role:=case when exists(
      select 1 from private.family_person_pending_roles pr
      where pr.family_person_id=v_fp.id and pr.role='admin'
    ) then 'admin' else 'member' end;

    update public.family_role_assignments
    set status='inactive',updated_at=now()
    where family_id=v_fp.family_id and user_id=new.linked_user_id and status='active';

    insert into public.family_role_assignments(
     family_id,user_id,role,status,granted_by,granted_at,created_at,updated_at
    ) values(
     v_fp.family_id,new.linked_user_id,v_role,'active',
     coalesce(
      (select pr.configured_by from private.family_person_pending_roles pr
       where pr.family_person_id=v_fp.id and pr.role='admin' limit 1),
      new.linked_user_id
     ),
     now(),now(),now()
    );
  end if;

  insert into public.person_self_access(
   family_person_id,family_id,
   can_view_profile,can_update_profile,
   can_view_medications,can_create_medications,can_update_medications,can_delete_medications,
   can_view_appointments,can_create_appointments,can_update_appointments,can_delete_appointments,
   can_view_health,can_create_health,can_update_health,can_delete_health,
   can_view_emergency,can_create_emergency,can_update_emergency,can_delete_emergency,
   configured_by,created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
   v_fp.id,v_fp.family_id,
   true,true,
   true,true,true,false,
   true,true,true,false,
   true,true,true,false,
   true,true,true,false,
   new.linked_user_id,now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_person_id) do nothing;

  -- When the person links their account, self becomes the primary health caregiver.
  select mp.primary_user_id into v_old_primary
  from private.medical_primary_responsibilities mp
  where mp.family_person_id=v_fp.id and mp.state='active';

  if v_old_primary is not null and v_old_primary is distinct from new.linked_user_id
     and exists(select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
                where fm.family_id=v_fp.family_id and fm.user_id=v_old_primary and fm.status='active') then
    insert into public.person_caregiver_assignments(
     family_id,family_person_id,caregiver_user_id,is_primary,
     can_edit_profile,can_manage_medications,can_manage_appointments,can_manage_health,can_manage_emergency,
     can_receive_notifications,status,assigned_by,assigned_at,created_at,updated_at
    ) values(
     v_fp.family_id,v_fp.id,v_old_primary,false,
     true,true,true,true,false,true,'active',new.linked_user_id,now(),now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(family_person_id,caregiver_user_id) do update set
     status='active',is_primary=false,can_edit_profile=true,can_manage_medications=true,
     can_manage_appointments=true,can_manage_health=true,can_manage_emergency=false,
     can_receive_notifications=true,updated_at=now();
  end if;

  insert into private.medical_primary_responsibilities(
   family_person_id,family_id,primary_user_id,state,authority_basis,assigned_by,assigned_at,created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
   v_fp.id,v_fp.family_id,new.linked_user_id,'active','linked_person_self',
   new.linked_user_id,now(),now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_person_id) do update set
   primary_user_id=new.linked_user_id,state='active',authority_basis='linked_person_self',
   assigned_by=new.linked_user_id,assigned_at=now(),updated_at=now();

  -- Apply health access that was explicitly prepared for this future account.
  for v_access in
   select * from private.family_person_pending_access pa
   where pa.subject_family_person_id=v_fp.id
  loop
    if v_access.is_caregiver then
      insert into public.person_caregiver_assignments(
       family_id,family_person_id,caregiver_user_id,is_primary,
       can_edit_profile,can_manage_medications,can_manage_appointments,can_manage_health,can_manage_emergency,
       can_receive_notifications,assigned_by,status,assigned_at,created_at,updated_at
      ) values(
       v_access.family_id,v_access.target_family_person_id,new.linked_user_id,false,
       v_access.profile_level='manage',
       v_access.medications_level='manage',
       v_access.appointments_level='manage',
       v_access.health_level='manage',
       v_access.emergency_level='manage',
       v_access.receive_notifications,v_access.configured_by,'active',now(),now(),now()
      )
      on conflict(family_person_id,caregiver_user_id) do update set
       status='active',is_primary=false,
       can_edit_profile=excluded.can_edit_profile,
       can_manage_medications=excluded.can_manage_medications,
       can_manage_appointments=excluded.can_manage_appointments,
       can_manage_health=excluded.can_manage_health,
       can_manage_emergency=excluded.can_manage_emergency,
       can_receive_notifications=excluded.can_receive_notifications,
       assigned_by=excluded.assigned_by,updated_at=now();
    end if;

    insert into public.person_permissions(
     family_id,family_person_id,user_id,resource,
     can_view,can_create,can_update,can_delete,can_receive_notifications,
     granted_by,status,created_at,updated_at
    )
    select
     v_access.family_id,v_access.target_family_person_id,new.linked_user_id,x.resource,
     x.level in ('view','manage'),x.level='manage',x.level='manage',x.level='manage',
     v_access.receive_notifications and x.level<>'none',
     v_access.configured_by,'active',now(),now()
    from (values
     ('persons'::text,v_access.profile_level),
     ('medications'::text,v_access.medications_level),
     ('appointments'::text,v_access.appointments_level),
     ('health_data'::text,v_access.health_level),
     ('emergency'::text,v_access.emergency_level)
    ) x(resource,level)
    on conflict(family_id,family_person_id,user_id,resource) do update set
     can_view=excluded.can_view,can_create=excluded.can_create,
     can_update=excluded.can_update,can_delete=excluded.can_delete,
     can_receive_notifications=excluded.can_receive_notifications,
     granted_by=excluded.granted_by,status='active',updated_at=now();
  end loop;

  delete from private.family_person_pending_roles where family_person_id=v_fp.id;
  delete from private.family_person_pending_access where subject_family_person_id=v_fp.id;
 end loop;

 return new;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.family_persons fp
    where fp.id=p_family_person_id
      and fp.setup_status='draft'
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
        where fm.family_id=fp.family_id

        fp.setup_created_by=p_user_id
        or private.user_has_family_role(p_user_id,fp.family_id,array['owner'])
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.caregiver_assignment_allows(p_user_id uuid, p_family_person_id uuid, p_resource text, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
  where ca.family_person_id=p_family_person_id
    and ca.caregiver_user_id=p_user_id and ca.status='active'
    and not private.phms_is_medical_primary(p_user_id,p_family_person_id)
    and case
      when p_resource='persons' and p_action in ('view','update') then ca.can_edit_profile
      when p_resource='medications' and p_action in ('view','create','update','delete') then ca.can_manage_medications
      when p_resource='appointments' and p_action in ('view','create','update','delete') then ca.can_manage_appointments
      when p_resource='health_data' and p_action in ('view','create','update','delete') then ca.can_manage_health
      when p_resource='emergency' and p_action in ('view','create','update','delete') then ca.can_manage_emergency
      when p_action='receive_notifications' then ca.can_receive_notifications
      else false end
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ensure_self_caregiver_for_family_user(p_family_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_assigned_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_fp uuid;
begin
  -- Compatibility helper: "can care for others" now means the member can manage
  -- their own data too. Do NOT create a self caregiver assignment.
  select fp.id into v_fp
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.family_id=p_family_id
    and p.linked_user_id=p_user_id
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  order by fp.created_at
  limit 1;

  if v_fp is null then return; end if;

  insert into public.person_self_access(
    family_person_id,family_id,
    can_view_profile,can_update_profile,
    can_view_medications,can_create_medications,can_update_medications,can_delete_medications,
    can_view_appointments,can_create_appointments,can_update_appointments,can_delete_appointments,
    can_view_health,can_create_health,can_update_health,can_delete_health,
    configured_by,created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
    v_fp,p_family_id,
    true,true,
    true,true,true,false,
    true,true,true,false,
    true,true,true,false,
    coalesce(p_assigned_by,p_user_id),now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_person_id) do update set
    can_view_profile=true,can_update_profile=true,
    can_view_medications=true,can_create_medications=true,can_update_medications=true,
    can_view_appointments=true,can_create_appointments=true,can_update_appointments=true,
    can_view_health=true,can_create_health=true,can_update_health=true,
    configured_by=excluded.configured_by,updated_at=now();
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.family_person_central_label(p_family_person_id uuid)

    nullif(btrim(fp.relationship_label),''),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.family_person_has_data_steward(p_family_person_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select
   not exists(
     select 1
     from public.family_persons fp
     join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
     where fp.id=p_family_person_id
       and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
       and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
   )
   or private.family_person_self_manage_enabled(p_family_person_id)
   or exists(
     select 1
     from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
     join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=ca.family_person_id
     join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
     where ca.family_person_id=p_family_person_id
       and ca.status='active'
       and ca.caregiver_user_id is distinct from p.linked_user_id
   );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.handle_new_family_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- A. User becomes an active member of the family
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.family_memberships (
    family_id,
    user_id,
    status,
    joined_at,
    updated_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    new.created_by,
    'active',
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict do nothing;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- B. Assign Primary Owner role in V2 role table
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.family_role_assignments (
    family_id,
    user_id,
    role,
    status,
    granted_by,
    granted_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    new.created_by,
    'owner',
    'active',
    new.created_by,
    now(),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict do nothing;


  return new;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_family_permission(p_family_id uuid, p_resource text, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select

    -- Owner ผ่านอัตโนมัติ
    private.is_family_owner(p_family_id)

    or exists (

      select 1
      from public.family_permissions fp

      where fp.family_id = p_family_id
        and fp.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and fp.resource = p_resource

        and case p_action

          when 'view'
            then fp.can_view

          when 'create'
            then fp.can_create

          when 'update'
            then fp.can_update

          when 'delete'
            then fp.can_delete

          when 'manage_permissions'
            then fp.can_manage_permissions

          else false

        end
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.person_label_for_viewer(p_viewer_user_id uuid, p_person_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      select nullif(btrim(v.display_label),'')
      from public.family_person_view_labels v
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=v.family_person_id
      join public.family_memberships fm
        on fm.family_id=fp.family_id
       and fm.user_id=p_viewer_user_id
       and fm.status='active'
      where v.viewer_user_id=p_viewer_user_id
        and fp.person_id=p_person_id
        and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
        and nullif(btrim(v.display_label),'') is not null
      order by
        exists(
          select 1
          from public.line_identities li
          join private.line_identity_contexts c on c.line_identity_id=li.id
          where li.user_id=p_viewer_user_id
            and li.is_active=true
            and c.active_family_id=fp.family_id
        ) desc,
        v.updated_at desc nulls last,
        v.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ),
    (select nullif(btrim(p.nickname),'') from public.persons p where p.id=p_person_id),
    (select nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name)),'') from public.persons p where p.id=p_person_id),
    (select nullif(btrim(p.display_name),'') from public.persons p where p.id=p_person_id),
    'ไม่ระบุชื่อ'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_appointment_component(p_appointment_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS TABLE(appointment_id uuid, distance integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive walk(appointment_id, distance, path) as (
    select p_appointment_id, 0::integer, array[p_appointment_id]::uuid[]
    union all
    select
      x.neighbor_id,
      w.distance + 1,
      w.path || x.neighbor_id
    from walk w
    join private.appointment_links l
      on l.deleted_at is null
     and (l.appointment_id_a = w.appointment_id or l.appointment_id_b = w.appointment_id)
    cross join lateral (
      select case
        when l.appointment_id_a = w.appointment_id then l.appointment_id_b
        else l.appointment_id_a
      end as neighbor_id
    ) x
    join public.appointments n
      on n.id = x.neighbor_id
     and n.deleted_at is null
    where w.distance < least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,200),1),500)
      and not x.neighbor_id = any(w.path)
  )
  select w.appointment_id, min(w.distance)::integer
  from walk w
  group by w.appointment_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_find_crud_record(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text, p_record_code text, p_action text DEFAULT 'view'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(resource_key text, record_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, target_person_id uuid, target_person_name text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_key text:=private.phms_crud_resource_key(p_resource);
  v_ctx record;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_record_code,'')));
  v_count integer;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if v_key is null then raise exception 'invalid_crud_resource'; end if;
  if length(v_code)<8 then raise exception 'record_code_too_short'; end if;

  select * into v_ctx
  from private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,v_key,p_action)
  limit 1;

  if v_key='medication' then
    select count(*) into v_count
    from public.person_medications pm
    where pm.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or pm.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(pm.id::text) like v_code||'%';

    select pm.id into v_id
    from public.person_medications pm
    where pm.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or pm.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(pm.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    order by pm.id::text
    limit 1;

  elsif v_key='appointment' then
    select count(*) into v_count
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or a.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(a.id::text) like v_code||'%';

    select a.id into v_id
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or a.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(a.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    order by a.id::text
    limit 1;

  elsif v_key='health' then
    select count(*) into v_count
    from public.health_measurements h
    where h.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or h.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(h.id::text) like v_code||'%';

    select h.id into v_id
    from public.health_measurements h
    where h.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or h.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(h.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    order by h.id::text
    limit 1;

  else
    select count(*) into v_count
    from public.medical_documents d
    where d.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or d.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(d.id::text) like v_code||'%';

    select d.id into v_id
    from public.medical_documents d
    where d.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (p_action='view' or d.deleted_at is null)
      and lower(d.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    order by d.id::text
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'crud_record_not_found'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'crud_record_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  return query select
    v_key,v_id,v_ctx.actor_user_id,v_ctx.target_person_id,
    v_ctx.target_person_name,v_ctx.active_family_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_generate_appointment_group_notifications(p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer:=0;
begin
  insert into public.notifications(
    family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
    event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
    channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
    payload,dedupe_key,updated_at
  )
  select
    a.family_id,null,a.person_id,a.family_person_id,
    case when ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit' then 'appointment_group_post_visit' else 'appointment_group_reminder' end,
    case when ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit' then '📝 หลังนัด: อย่าลืมบันทึกข้อมูล' else '📅 เตือนนัดหมาย' end,
    case when ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit' then
      concat(
        '👤 ',private.phms_group_person_label(a.person_id,a.family_person_id),
        E'\nนัด: ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
        E'\nถึงเวลาบันทึกข้อมูลหลังนัดแล้ว'
      )
    else
      concat(
        '👤 ',private.phms_group_person_label(a.person_id,a.family_person_id),
        E'\nนัด: ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
        E'\nวันเวลา: ',to_char(a.appointment_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
        case when nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),'') is not null then E'\nสถานพยาบาล: '||a.hospital_name else '' end,
        case when nullif(btrim(a.department),'') is not null then E'\nแผนก: '||a.department else '' end,
        case when coalesce(pt.pending_count,0)>0 then E'\nยังต้องเตรียมอีก '||pt.pending_count::text||' รายการ' else '' end
      )
    end,
    a.id,'line','normal','pending',ar.remind_at,ar.remind_at,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'line_destination_type','group',
      'line_destination_id',gt.line_group_id,
      'group_target_id',gt.id,
      'appointment_reminder_id',ar.id,
      'rule_key',ar.rule_key,
      'appointment_id',a.id,
      'appointment_code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
      'appointment_status',a.status,
      'appointment_title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
      'hospital_name',nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),
      'department',nullif(btrim(a.department),''),
      'doctor_name',nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),''),
      'location_detail',nullif(btrim(a.location_detail),''),
      'person_name',private.phms_group_person_label(a.person_id,a.family_person_id),
      'set_by_name',case
        when coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by,a.created_by) is not null
          then private.family_user_central_nickname(a.family_id,coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by,a.created_by))
        else null
      end,
      'post_visit',ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit',
      'pending_tasks',case when (ar.rule_key like 'calendar_pre_%' or ar.rule_key like 'auto_pre_%') then pt.pending_tasks else null end
    )),
    concat('appointment_group:',gt.id::text,':',ar.rule_key,':',extract(epoch from ar.remind_at)::bigint::text),
    now()
  from (
    select distinct on (appointment_id,rule_key,remind_at)
      id,appointment_id,rule_key,remind_at
    from public.appointment_reminders
    where channel='line' and status='pending' and remind_at is not null and remind_at<=p_now+interval '5 minutes'
    order by appointment_id,rule_key,remind_at,id
  ) ar
  join public.appointments a on a.id=ar.appointment_id
  join public.appointment_line_group_targets gt on gt.appointment_id=a.id and gt.status='active'
  left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=a.id
  left join lateral (
    select count(*)::int pending_count,
           jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('task_code',substr(t.id::text,1,12),'title',t.title) order by t.created_at) pending_tasks
    from public.appointment_tasks t
    where t.appointment_id=a.id and t.status='pending'
  ) pt on true
  where a.deleted_at is null
    and (
      ((ar.rule_key like 'calendar_pre_%' or ar.rule_key like 'auto_pre_%')
       and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed') and a.appointment_at>p_now)
      or
      (ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit'
       and a.status in ('confirmed','arrived','completed')
       and a.followup_recorded_at is null)
    )
  on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count=row_count;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

          then E'\nแผนก: '||a.department else '' end,
        case when coalesce(pt.pending_count,0)>0
          then E'\nยังต้องเตรียมอีก '||pt.pending_count::text||' รายการ' else '' end
      )
    end,
    a.id,'line','normal','pending',ar.remind_at,ar.remind_at,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'appointment_reminder_id',ar.id,
      'rule_key',ar.rule_key,
      'appointment_id',a.id,
      'appointment_code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
      'appointment_status',a.status,
      'appointment_title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
      'hospital_name',nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),
      'department',nullif(btrim(a.department),''),
      'doctor_name',nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),''),
      'location_detail',nullif(btrim(a.location_detail),''),
      'arrival_lead_minutes',a.arrival_lead_minutes,
      'person_id',a.person_id,
      'person_name',private.phms_notification_person_label(ar.recipient_user_id,a.person_id,a.family_person_id),
      'set_by_name',case
        when coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by,a.created_by) is not null
          then private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
            ar.recipient_user_id,a.family_id,coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by,a.created_by)
          )
        else null
      end,
      'post_visit',ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit',
      'pending_tasks',case when (ar.rule_key like 'auto_pre_%' or ar.rule_key like 'calendar_pre_%') then pt.pending_tasks else null end
    )),
    concat('appointment:',ar.id::text,':',extract(epoch from ar.remind_at)::bigint::text),
    now()
  from public.appointment_reminders ar
  join public.appointments a on a.id=ar.appointment_id
  left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=a.id
  left join lateral (
    select count(*)::int pending_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object('task_code',substr(t.id::text,1,12),'title',t.title)
             order by t.created_at
           ) pending_tasks
    from public.appointment_tasks t
    where t.appointment_id=a.id and t.status='pending'
  ) pt on true
  where ar.channel='line'
    and ar.status='pending'
    and ar.recipient_user_id is not null
    and ar.remind_at is not null
    and ar.remind_at<=p_now+interval '5 minutes'
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and (
      ((ar.rule_key like 'auto_pre_%' or ar.rule_key like 'calendar_pre_%')
        and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
        and a.appointment_at>p_now)
      or
      (ar.rule_key='auto_post_visit'
        and a.status in ('confirmed','arrived','completed')
        and a.followup_recorded_at is null)
    )
    and exists(
      select 1
      from private.phms_notification_recipients(a.person_id,'appointments') r
      where r.recipient_user_id=ar.recipient_user_id
    )
  on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count=row_count;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_generate_medication_notifications(p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer:=0;
begin
  with local_dates as (
    select ((p_now at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date + g)::date as dose_date
    from generate_series(-1,1) g
  ),
  policy_times as (
    select
      pm.id person_medication_id,
      pm.person_id,
      r.id regimen_id,
      tp.id timing_policy_id,
      concat('policy:',tp.id::text) source_key,
      (
        (d.dose_date + tp.household_time)
        at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      ) dose_at,
      (
        (
          (d.dose_date + tp.household_time)
          at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
        )
        - make_interval(mins=>tp.reminder_offset_minutes)
      ) scheduled_for,
      p.display_name,
      p.first_name,
      p.last_name,
      mm.generic_name,
      mm.brand_name,
      mm.strength_value,
      mm.strength_unit,
      r.dose_text,
      r.instructions
    from public.person_medications pm
    join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
    join public.medication_regimens r
      on r.person_medication_id=pm.id
     and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.is_current=true
    join public.medication_timing_policies tp
      on tp.person_medication_id=pm.id
     and tp.deleted_at is null
     and tp.active=true
     and tp.household_time is not null
     and (tp.regimen_id is null or tp.regimen_id=r.id)
    join public.persons p on p.id=pm.person_id
    cross join local_dates d
    where pm.deleted_at is null
      and pm.status='regular'
      and mm.deleted_at is null
      and mm.status='active'
      and (pm.start_date is null or d.dose_date>=pm.start_date)
      and (pm.end_date is null or d.dose_date<=pm.end_date)
      and r.effective_from<=(
        (d.dose_date + tp.household_time) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      )
      and (
        r.effective_to is null
        or r.effective_to>(
          (d.dose_date + tp.household_time) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
        )
      )
      and tp.effective_from<=(
        (d.dose_date + tp.household_time) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      )
      and (
        tp.effective_to is null
        or tp.effective_to>(
          (d.dose_date + tp.household_time) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
        )
      )
  ),
  exact_times as (
    select
      pm.id person_medication_id,
      pm.person_id,
      r.id regimen_id,
      null::uuid timing_policy_id,
      concat('exact:',to_char(t.x,'HH24:MI:SS')) source_key,
      (
        (d.dose_date + t.x)
        at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      ) dose_at,
      (
        (d.dose_date + t.x)
        at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      ) scheduled_for,
      p.display_name,
      p.first_name,
      p.last_name,
      mm.generic_name,
      mm.brand_name,
      mm.strength_value,
      mm.strength_unit,
      r.dose_text,
      r.instructions
    from public.person_medications pm
    join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
    join public.medication_regimens r
      on r.person_medication_id=pm.id
     and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.is_current=true
    join public.persons p on p.id=pm.person_id
    cross join local_dates d
    cross join lateral unnest(coalesce(r.exact_times,array[]::time[])) t(x)
    where pm.deleted_at is null
      and pm.status='regular'
      and mm.deleted_at is null
      and mm.status='active'
      and (pm.start_date is null or d.dose_date>=pm.start_date)
      and (pm.end_date is null or d.dose_date<=pm.end_date)
      and r.effective_from<=(
        (d.dose_date + t.x) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      )
      and (
        r.effective_to is null
        or r.effective_to>(
          (d.dose_date + t.x) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
        )
      )
      and not exists(
        select 1
        from public.medication_timing_policies tp
        where tp.person_medication_id=pm.id
          and tp.deleted_at is null
          and tp.active=true
          and tp.household_time is not null
          and (tp.regimen_id is null or tp.regimen_id=r.id)
          and tp.effective_from<=(
            (d.dose_date + t.x) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
          )
          and (
            tp.effective_to is null
            or tp.effective_to>(
              (d.dose_date + t.x) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
            )
          )
      )
  ),
  schedules as (
    select * from policy_times
    union all
    select * from exact_times
  ),
  due as (
    select s.*,rec.recipient_user_id,rec.family_id
    from schedules s
    cross join lateral private.phms_notification_recipients(
      s.person_id,'medications'
    ) rec
    where s.scheduled_for>=p_now-interval '60 minutes'
      and s.scheduled_for<=p_now+interval '5 minutes'
  )
  insert into public.notifications(
    family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,
    event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
    channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
    payload,dedupe_key,updated_at
  )
  select
    d.family_id,
    d.recipient_user_id,
    d.person_id,
    'medication_reminder',
    '💊 เตือนยา',
    concat(
      '👤 ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.display_name),''),
        nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',d.first_name,d.last_name)),''),
        'ผู้ใช้'),
      E'\nยา: ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.brand_name),''),d.generic_name),
      case
        when d.strength_value is not null
          then ' '||trim(to_char(d.strength_value,'FM999999990.######'))
               ||coalesce(' '||nullif(btrim(d.strength_unit),''),'')
        else ''
      end,
      E'\nตารางเวลา: ',to_char(d.dose_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
      case when nullif(btrim(d.dose_text),'') is not null
        then E'\nขนาด: '||d.dose_text else '' end,
      case when nullif(btrim(d.instructions),'') is not null
        then E'\nวิธีใช้: '||d.instructions else '' end
    ),
    d.person_medication_id,
    'line',
    'normal',
    'pending',
    d.scheduled_for,
    d.scheduled_for,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'person_medication_id',d.person_medication_id,
      'regimen_id',d.regimen_id,
      'timing_policy_id',d.timing_policy_id,
      'source_key',d.source_key,
      'dose_at',d.dose_at,
      'person_id',d.person_id
    )),
    concat(
      'medication:',d.person_medication_id::text,':',
      d.regimen_id::text,':',d.source_key,':',
      d.recipient_user_id::text,':',
      extract(epoch from d.dose_at)::bigint::text
    ),
    now()
  from due d
  on conflict (dedupe_key)
    where dedupe_key is not null
  do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count=row_count;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

   when v ~ '^รพ[.]' then v

 end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_learn_appointment_confirmation(p_appointment_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_unit uuid;
begin
  select * into v from public.appointments where id=p_appointment_id;
  if not found or v.deleted_at is not null or v.organization_id is null then return; end if;

  v_unit:=coalesce(v.service_unit_id,private.phms_match_service_unit(v.organization_id,v.department));

  insert into private.person_appointment_memory(
    person_id,organization_id,service_unit_id,
    last_doctor_name,last_coverage_type,last_arrival_lead_minutes,last_care_topic,
    last_confirmed_appointment_id,confirmation_count,source,confirmed_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    v.person_id,v.organization_id,v_unit,
    nullif(btrim(v.doctor_name),''),
    nullif(btrim(v.coverage_type),''),
    v.arrival_lead_minutes,
    nullif(btrim(v.care_topic),''),
    v.id,1,'confirmed_appointment',now(),now()
  )
  on conflict (
    person_id,organization_id,(coalesce(service_unit_id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid))
  )
  do update set
    last_doctor_name=coalesce(excluded.last_doctor_name,private.person_appointment_memory.last_doctor_name),
    last_coverage_type=coalesce(excluded.last_coverage_type,private.person_appointment_memory.last_coverage_type),
    last_arrival_lead_minutes=coalesce(excluded.last_arrival_lead_minutes,private.person_appointment_memory.last_arrival_lead_minutes),
    last_care_topic=coalesce(excluded.last_care_topic,private.person_appointment_memory.last_care_topic),
    last_confirmed_appointment_id=excluded.last_confirmed_appointment_id,
    confirmation_count=private.person_appointment_memory.confirmation_count+1,
    source='confirmed_appointment',
    confirmed_at=now(),
    updated_at=now();

  if v_unit is not null and nullif(btrim(coalesce(v.location_detail,'')),'') is not null then
    insert into private.service_unit_observations(
      service_unit_id,field_name,field_value,normalized_value,last_appointment_id
    )
    values(
      v_unit,'location_detail',btrim(v.location_detail),
      private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(v.location_detail),v.id
    )
    on conflict (service_unit_id,field_name,normalized_value)
    do update set
      field_value=excluded.field_value,
      confirmation_count=private.service_unit_observations.confirmation_count+1,
      last_appointment_id=excluded.last_appointment_id,
      last_confirmed_at=now(),
      updated_at=now();
  end if;

  if v_unit is not null and nullif(btrim(coalesce(v.contact_phone,'')),'') is not null then
    insert into private.service_unit_observations(
      service_unit_id,field_name,field_value,normalized_value,last_appointment_id
    )
    values(
      v_unit,'contact_phone',btrim(v.contact_phone),
      md5(lower(btrim(v.contact_phone))),v.id
    )
    on conflict (service_unit_id,field_name,normalized_value)
    do update set
      field_value=excluded.field_value,
      confirmation_count=private.service_unit_observations.confirmation_count+1,
      last_appointment_id=excluded.last_appointment_id,
      last_confirmed_at=now(),
      updated_at=now();
  end if;

  if v_unit is not null and nullif(btrim(coalesce(v.contact_email,'')),'') is not null
     and v.contact_email ~* '^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+[.][A-Z]{2,}$' then
    insert into private.service_unit_observations(
      service_unit_id,field_name,field_value,normalized_value,last_appointment_id
    )
    values(
      v_unit,'contact_email',lower(btrim(v.contact_email)),
      lower(btrim(v.contact_email)),v.id
    )
    on conflict (service_unit_id,field_name,normalized_value)
    do update set
      field_value=excluded.field_value,
      confirmation_count=private.service_unit_observations.confirmation_count+1,
      last_appointment_id=excluded.last_appointment_id,
      last_confirmed_at=now(),
      updated_at=now();
  end if;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_match_service_unit(p_organization_id uuid, p_department text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_norm text:=private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(private.phms_normalize_appointment_department(p_department));
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if p_organization_id is null or v_norm is null then return null; end if;

  select a.service_unit_id into v_id
  from private.healthcare_directory_aliases a
  where a.entity_type='service_unit'
    and a.organization_id=p_organization_id
    and a.is_active
    and a.normalized_alias=v_norm
  order by case when a.confidence='high' then 0 when a.confidence='medium' then 1 else 2 end,
           a.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_id is not null then return v_id; end if;

  select u.id into v_id
  from public.healthcare_service_units u
  where u.organization_id=p_organization_id
    and u.deleted_at is null
    and (
      private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(u.name)=v_norm
      or private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(u.code)=private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(p_department)
      or private.phms_normalize_directory_alias(
        u.name||case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(u.code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||u.code||')' else '' end
      )=v_norm
    )
  order by u.is_verified desc,u.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  return v_id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_med_action_permission(p_action text)
 RETURNS text

 WHEN p_action IN ('med.list','med.detail','med.schedule.today','med.stock.summary','med.report.daily','med.report.emergency') THEN 'view'
 WHEN p_action IN ('med.intake.start','med.administration.record','med.stock.receive','med.preparation.start') THEN 'create'

 ELSE NULL END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_notification_recipients(p_person_id uuid, p_resource text)
 RETURNS TABLE(recipient_user_id uuid, family_id uuid, line_user_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  with person_rows as (
    select fp.id as family_person_id,fp.family_id
    from public.family_persons fp
    where fp.person_id=p_person_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
  ),
  candidates as (
    select fm.user_id,pr.family_id,1 as priority
    from person_rows pr
    join public.family_memberships fm
      on fm.family_id=pr.family_id
     and fm.status='active'
    where private.person_notification_enabled(
      fm.user_id,pr.family_person_id,p_resource
    )

    union all

    select p.linked_user_id,pr.family_id,0
    from public.persons p
    join person_rows pr on true
    where p.id=p_person_id
      and p.linked_user_id is not null
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(
        (
          select np.enabled
          from public.person_notification_preferences np
          where np.family_person_id=pr.family_person_id
            and np.user_id=p.linked_user_id
            and np.resource=case lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')))
              when 'health' then 'health_data'
              when 'medication' then 'medications'
              else lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')))
            end
          limit 1
        ),
        true
      )
  ),
  ranked as (
    select c.user_id,c.family_id,c.priority,
           row_number() over(
             partition by c.user_id
             order by c.priority,c.family_id nulls first
           ) rn
    from candidates c
    where c.user_id is not null
  )
  select r.user_id,r.family_id,li.line_user_id
  from ranked r
  join lateral (
    select x.line_user_id
    from public.line_identities x
    where x.user_id=r.user_id
      and coalesce(x.is_active,false)=true
      and x.onboarding_status='ready'
    order by x.updated_at desc nulls last,x.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) li on true
  where r.rn=1
    and private.phms_real_data_notification_allowed(
      p_person_id,p_resource
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_real_data_notification_allowed(p_person_id uuid, p_resource text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_global boolean:=false;
  v_resource text;
begin
  select coalesce(allow_real_data,false)
  into v_global
  from public.phms_runtime_environment
  where environment='production'
  limit 1;

  if coalesce(v_global,false) then
    return true;
  end if;

  v_resource:=case lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')))
    when 'medications' then 'medication'
    when 'person_medications' then 'medication'
    when 'appointments' then 'appointment'
    when 'health_data' then 'health'
    when 'health_measurement' then 'health'
    when 'health_measurements' then 'health'
    when 'measurement' then 'health'
    when 'medical_document' then 'document'
    when 'medical_documents' then 'document'
    when 'documents' then 'document'
    else lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')))
  end;

  return exists(
    select 1
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.families f on f.id=fp.family_id
    join private.phms_real_data_pilot_families rp
      on rp.family_id=fp.family_id
    where fp.person_id=p_person_id
      and fp.status='active'
      and f.status='active'
      and rp.status='active'
      and rp.allow_notifications=true
      and now()>=rp.starts_at
      and (rp.ends_at is null or now()<rp.ends_at)
      and v_resource=any(rp.allowed_resources)
      and (
        select count(*)
        from public.family_persons x
        where x.family_id=fp.family_id
          and x.status='active'
      )<=rp.max_people
  );
end
$function$

    (array_agg(l.family_id ORDER BY f.family_name,f.id))[1]
  into v_family_names,v_notification_family
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and l.status='active';

  if v_notification_family is null then return null; end if;

  v_when:=(

  update public.notifications
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='replaced_by_new_group_setup_reminder',
      updated_at=now()
  where event_type='line_group_setup_reminder'
    and related_record_id=v_fc.id
    and recipient_user_id=p_recipient_user_id
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  insert into public.notifications(
    family_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
    channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,
    created_at,updated_at

    '💙 เหลือตั้งค่า LINE กลุ่มอีกนิด',

    ),
    v_fc.id,'line','normal','pending',v_when,v_when,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'group_code',substr(v_fc.id::text,1,12),
      'line_group_id',v_fc.external_channel_id,
      'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      'family_names',nullif(v_family_names,''),
      'timezone','Asia/Bangkok'
    )),
    'line-group-setup-reminder:'||v_fc.id::text||':'||p_recipient_user_id::text,
    now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,
    message=excluded.message,
    payload=excluded.payload,
    status='pending',
    scheduled_for=excluded.scheduled_for,
    next_attempt_at=excluded.next_attempt_at,
    last_error=null,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_sync_auto_appointment_reminders(p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_upserted integer:=0;
  v_group_seed_upserted integer:=0;
  v_post_upserted integer:=0;
  v_cancelled integer:=0;
begin
  update public.appointment_reminders
  set status='cancelled',updated_at=now()
  where rule_key like 'auto_pre_%'
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  with base as (
    select a.id appointment_id,a.person_id,a.appointment_at,
           coalesce(s.days_before,array[3]) days_before,
           coalesce(s.local_time,'09:00'::time) local_time,
           coalesce(s.recipient_mode,'default') recipient_mode
    from public.appointments a
    left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=a.id
    where a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
      and a.appointment_at is not null
      and a.appointment_at>p_now
  ), desired as (
    select b.appointment_id,b.person_id,b.appointment_at,d.days_before,b.local_time,b.recipient_mode,
           private.phms_calendar_appointment_remind_at(b.appointment_at,d.days_before,b.local_time) remind_at,
           'calendar_pre_'||d.days_before::text||'d_'||to_char(b.local_time,'HH24MI') rule_key
    from base b
    cross join lateral unnest(b.days_before) d(days_before)
  ), recips as (
    select d.*,r.recipient_user_id
    from desired d
    cross join lateral (
      select nr.recipient_user_id
      from private.phms_notification_recipients(d.person_id,'appointments') nr
      where d.recipient_mode='default'
      union
      select t.user_id
      from public.appointment_notification_user_targets t
      where d.recipient_mode='custom'
        and t.appointment_id=d.appointment_id and t.enabled=true
        and exists(
          select 1 from private.phms_notification_recipients(d.person_id,'appointments') nr2
          where nr2.recipient_user_id=t.user_id
        )
    ) r
    where d.remind_at>p_now
  )
  insert into public.appointment_reminders(
    appointment_id,recipient_user_id,remind_at,channel,status,rule_key,updated_at
  )
  select appointment_id,recipient_user_id,remind_at,'line','pending',rule_key,now()
  from recips
  on conflict(appointment_id,recipient_user_id,rule_key)
    where appointment_id is not null and recipient_user_id is not null and rule_key is not null
  do update set
    remind_at=excluded.remind_at,channel='line',
    status=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then 'pending'
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then 'pending'
      else public.appointment_reminders.status end,
    sent_at=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then null
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then null
      else public.appointment_reminders.sent_at end,
    updated_at=now();
  get diagnostics v_user_upserted=row_count;

  with base as (
    select a.id appointment_id,a.appointment_at,
           coalesce(s.days_before,array[3]) days_before,
           coalesce(s.local_time,'09:00'::time) local_time
    from public.appointments a
    left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=a.id
    where a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
      and a.appointment_at is not null
      and a.appointment_at>p_now
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.appointment_line_group_targets gt
        where gt.appointment_id=a.id and gt.status='active'
      )
  ), desired as (
    select b.appointment_id,d.days_before,b.local_time,
           private.phms_calendar_appointment_remind_at(b.appointment_at,d.days_before,b.local_time) remind_at,
           'calendar_pre_'||d.days_before::text||'d_'||to_char(b.local_time,'HH24MI') rule_key
    from base b cross join lateral unnest(b.days_before) d(days_before)
  )
  insert into public.appointment_reminders(
    appointment_id,recipient_user_id,remind_at,channel,status,rule_key,updated_at
  )
  select appointment_id,null,remind_at,'line','pending',rule_key,now()
  from desired
  where remind_at>p_now
  on conflict(appointment_id,rule_key)
    where appointment_id is not null and recipient_user_id is null and rule_key is not null
  do update set
    remind_at=excluded.remind_at,channel='line',
    status=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then 'pending'
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then 'pending'
      else public.appointment_reminders.status end,
    sent_at=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then null
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then null
      else public.appointment_reminders.sent_at end,
    updated_at=now();
  get diagnostics v_group_seed_upserted=row_count;

  with desired as (
    select a.id appointment_id,d.days_before,
           private.phms_calendar_appointment_remind_at(
             a.appointment_at,d.days_before,coalesce(s.local_time,'09:00'::time)
           ) remind_at,
           'calendar_pre_'||d.days_before::text||'d_'||to_char(coalesce(s.local_time,'09:00'::time),'HH24MI') rule_key,
           coalesce(s.recipient_mode,'default') recipient_mode,
           a.person_id
    from public.appointments a
    left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=a.id
    cross join lateral unnest(coalesce(s.days_before,array[3])) d(days_before)
    where a.deleted_at is null and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
      and a.appointment_at is not null and a.appointment_at>p_now
  ), valid_rows as (
    select d.appointment_id,d.rule_key,d.remind_at,r.recipient_user_id
    from desired d
    cross join lateral (
      select nr.recipient_user_id
      from private.phms_notification_recipients(d.person_id,'appointments') nr
      where d.recipient_mode='default'
      union
      select t.user_id
      from public.appointment_notification_user_targets t
      where d.recipient_mode='custom' and t.appointment_id=d.appointment_id and t.enabled=true
        and exists(
          select 1 from private.phms_notification_recipients(d.person_id,'appointments') nr2
          where nr2.recipient_user_id=t.user_id
        )
    ) r
    union all
    select d.appointment_id,d.rule_key,d.remind_at,null::uuid
    from desired d
    where exists(
      select 1 from public.appointment_line_group_targets gt
      where gt.appointment_id=d.appointment_id and gt.status='active'
    )
  )
  update public.appointment_reminders ar
  set status='cancelled',updated_at=now()
  where ar.rule_key like 'calendar_pre_%'
    and ar.status in ('pending','failed')
    and not exists(
      select 1 from valid_rows v
      where v.appointment_id=ar.appointment_id
        and v.rule_key=ar.rule_key
        and v.remind_at is not distinct from ar.remind_at
        and v.recipient_user_id is not distinct from ar.recipient_user_id
    );
  get diagnostics v_cancelled=row_count;

  insert into public.appointment_reminders(
    appointment_id,recipient_user_id,remind_at,channel,status,rule_key,updated_at
  )
  select
    a.id,r.recipient_user_id,pst.remind_at,'line','pending','auto_post_visit',now()
  from public.appointments a
  cross join lateral private.phms_notification_recipients(a.person_id,'appointments') r
  cross join lateral (
    select case
      when a.post_visit_followup_time_local is not null then greatest(
        (((a.appointment_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date + a.post_visit_followup_time_local) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'),
        coalesce(a.completed_at,a.appointment_at)+interval '30 minutes'
      )
      when a.post_visit_followup_minutes>0 then coalesce(a.completed_at,a.appointment_at)+make_interval(mins=>a.post_visit_followup_minutes)
      else null
    end remind_at
  ) pst
  where a.deleted_at is null
    and a.status in ('confirmed','arrived','completed')
    and a.appointment_at is not null
    and (a.post_visit_followup_time_local is not null or a.post_visit_followup_minutes>0)
    and a.followup_recorded_at is null
    and pst.remind_at is not null
    and pst.remind_at>p_now-interval '24 hours'
  on conflict(appointment_id,recipient_user_id,rule_key)
    where appointment_id is not null and recipient_user_id is not null and rule_key is not null
  do update set
    remind_at=excluded.remind_at,channel='line',
    status=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then 'pending'
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then 'pending'
      else public.appointment_reminders.status end,
    sent_at=case
      when public.appointment_reminders.remind_at is distinct from excluded.remind_at then null
      when public.appointment_reminders.status in ('cancelled','failed') then null
      else public.appointment_reminders.sent_at end,
    updated_at=now();
  get diagnostics v_post_upserted=row_count;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'calendar_user_upserted',v_user_upserted,
    'calendar_group_seed_upserted',v_group_seed_upserted,
    'post_visit_upserted',v_post_upserted,
    'cancelled',v_cancelled
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.phms_sync_encounter_from_appointment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_encounter_id uuid;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_start timestamptz;
begin
  if new.status<>'completed' then
    return new;
  end if;

  v_encounter_id:=new.encounter_id;
  v_end:=coalesce(new.completed_at,now());
  v_start:=least(
    coalesce(new.arrived_at,new.appointment_at,v_end),
    v_end
  );

  if v_encounter_id is null then
    insert into public.encounters(
      person_id,organization_id,service_unit_id,clinician_id,
      encounter_type,external_visit_no,started_at,ended_at,reason,summary,status,created_by,
      treatment_episode_id
    ) values(
      new.person_id,new.organization_id,new.service_unit_id,new.clinician_id,
      'outpatient',new.hospital_vn,
      v_start,
      v_end,
      new.title,
      nullif(btrim(new.visit_outcome_notes),''),
      'completed',
      new.created_by,
      new.treatment_episode_id
    )
    returning id into v_encounter_id;

    update public.appointments
    set encounter_id=v_encounter_id,updated_at=now()
    where id=new.id and encounter_id is null;
  else
    update public.encounters
    set person_id=new.person_id,
        organization_id=new.organization_id,
        service_unit_id=new.service_unit_id,
        clinician_id=new.clinician_id,
        external_visit_no=coalesce(nullif(btrim(new.hospital_vn),''),external_visit_no),
        encounter_type=coalesce(encounter_type,'outpatient'),
        started_at=v_start,
        ended_at=v_end,
        reason=new.title,
        summary=coalesce(nullif(btrim(new.visit_outcome_notes),''),summary),
        status='completed',
        treatment_episode_id=coalesce(new.treatment_episode_id,treatment_episode_id),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_encounter_id and deleted_at is null;
  end if;

  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_care_assistant_from_person_permissions(p_family_person_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_actor uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 v_family_id uuid;v_subject_user uuid;v_primary uuid;
 v_profile boolean:=false;v_med boolean:=false;v_appt boolean:=false;
 v_health boolean:=false;v_emergency boolean:=false;v_notify boolean:=false;
begin
 select fp.family_id,p.linked_user_id
 into v_family_id,v_subject_user
 from public.family_persons fp
 join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
 where fp.id=p_family_person_id;

 if v_family_id is null or p_user_id is null then return; end if;

 select mp.primary_user_id into v_primary
 from private.medical_primary_responsibilities mp
 where mp.family_person_id=p_family_person_id and mp.state='active';

 if p_user_id=v_subject_user or p_user_id=v_primary then
  update public.person_caregiver_assignments
  set status='inactive',is_primary=false,updated_at=now()
  where family_person_id=p_family_person_id and caregiver_user_id=p_user_id and status='active';
  return;
 end if;

 select
  coalesce(bool_or(resource='persons' and (can_create or can_update or can_delete)),false),
  coalesce(bool_or(resource='medications' and (can_create or can_update or can_delete)),false),
  coalesce(bool_or(resource='appointments' and (can_create or can_update or can_delete)),false),
  coalesce(bool_or(resource='health_data' and (can_create or can_update or can_delete)),false),
  coalesce(bool_or(resource='emergency' and (can_create or can_update or can_delete)),false),
  coalesce(bool_or(can_receive_notifications),false)
 into v_profile,v_med,v_appt,v_health,v_emergency,v_notify
 from public.person_permissions
 where family_id=v_family_id and family_person_id=p_family_person_id
   and user_id=p_user_id and status='active';

 if v_profile or v_med or v_appt or v_health or v_emergency then
  insert into public.person_caregiver_assignments(
   family_id,family_person_id,caregiver_user_id,is_primary,
   can_edit_profile,can_manage_medications,can_manage_appointments,can_manage_health,can_manage_emergency,
   can_receive_notifications,status,assigned_by,assigned_at,created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
   v_family_id,p_family_person_id,p_user_id,false,
   v_profile,v_med,v_appt,v_health,v_emergency,v_notify,'active',
   coalesce(p_actor,p_user_id),now(),now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_person_id,caregiver_user_id) do update set
   status='active',is_primary=false,
   can_edit_profile=excluded.can_edit_profile,
   can_manage_medications=excluded.can_manage_medications,
   can_manage_appointments=excluded.can_manage_appointments,
   can_manage_health=excluded.can_manage_health,
   can_manage_emergency=excluded.can_manage_emergency,
   can_receive_notifications=excluded.can_receive_notifications,
   assigned_by=coalesce(p_actor,public.person_caregiver_assignments.assigned_by),
   updated_at=now();
 else
  update public.person_caregiver_assignments
  set status='inactive',is_primary=false,updated_at=now()
  where family_person_id=p_family_person_id and caregiver_user_id=p_user_id and status='active';
 end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_caregiver_permission_rows()

  v_manage boolean;

      when 'medications' then new.can_manage_medications
      when 'appointments' then new.can_manage_appointments

    end;

      new.status='active',

      new.status='active' and v_manage,
      new.status='active' and v_manage,
      new.status='active',
      new.assigned_by,'active',now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(family_id,family_person_id,user_id,resource)
    do update set
      can_view=excluded.can_view,
      can_create=excluded.can_create,
      can_update=excluded.can_update,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_self_manage_from_caregiver()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_linked uuid;
begin
 if new.status='active' then
   select p.linked_user_id into v_linked
   from public.family_persons fp join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
   where fp.id=new.family_person_id;
   if v_linked is not null and v_linked=new.caregiver_user_id then
     insert into public.person_self_access(
       family_person_id,family_id,can_view_profile,can_update_profile,
       can_view_medications,can_create_medications,can_update_medications,
       can_view_appointments,can_create_appointments,can_update_appointments,
       can_view_health,can_create_health,can_update_health,configured_by)
     values(
       new.family_person_id,new.family_id,true,true,true,true,true,true,true,true,true,true,true,new.assigned_by)
     on conflict(family_person_id) do update set
       can_view_profile=true,can_update_profile=true,
       can_view_medications=true,can_create_medications=true,can_update_medications=true,
       can_view_appointments=true,can_create_appointments=true,can_update_appointments=true,
       can_view_health=true,can_create_health=true,can_update_health=true,
       configured_by=excluded.configured_by,updated_at=now();
   end if;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_can_see_family_person(p_user_id uuid, p_family_person_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.family_persons fp
    where fp.id=p_family_person_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
        where fm.family_id=fp.family_id
          and fm.user_id=p_user_id
          and fm.status='active'
      )
      and (
        private.can_manage_family_person_setup(p_user_id,fp.id)
        or (
          private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(p_user_id,fp.id)
          and (
            private.user_has_family_role(p_user_id,fp.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
            or private.self_person_access_allowed(p_user_id,fp.id,'persons','view')
            or private.caregiver_assignment_allows(p_user_id,fp.id,'persons','view')
            or exists(
              select 1 from public.person_permissions x
              where x.family_id=fp.family_id
                and x.family_person_id=fp.id
                and x.user_id=p_user_id
                and x.status='active'
                and (
                  coalesce(x.can_view,false)
                  or coalesce(x.can_create,false)
                  or coalesce(x.can_update,false)
                  or coalesce(x.can_delete,false)
                )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_has_family_role(p_user_id uuid, p_family_id uuid, p_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select
  exists(
   select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fra
   where fra.family_id=p_family_id and fra.user_id=p_user_id
     and fra.status='active' and fra.role=any(p_roles)
  )
  or ('caregiver'=any(p_roles) and (
    exists(select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
           where ca.family_id=p_family_id and ca.caregiver_user_id=p_user_id and ca.status='active')
    or exists(select 1 from private.medical_primary_responsibilities mp
              where mp.family_id=p_family_id and mp.primary_user_id=p_user_id and mp.state='active')
  ))
  or ('viewer'=any(p_roles) and exists(
    select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
    where pp.family_id=p_family_id and pp.user_id=p_user_id and pp.status='active'
      and (coalesce(pp.can_view,false) or coalesce(pp.can_create,false)
           or coalesce(pp.can_update,false) or coalesce(pp.can_delete,false))
  ))
  or ('patient'=any(p_roles) and exists(
    select 1 from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.family_id=p_family_id and p.linked_user_id=p_user_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active' and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  ));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_self_profile_update_allowed(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not exists(
   select 1
   from public.persons p
   join public.family_persons fp
     on fp.person_id=p.id and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
   join public.family_memberships fm
     on fm.family_id=fp.family_id and fm.user_id=p_user_id and fm.status='active'
   left join public.person_self_access sa on sa.family_person_id=fp.id
   where p.linked_user_id=p_user_id
     and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
     and coalesce(sa.can_update_profile,true)=false
 );
$function$
